context.content: I'm an incoming FAANG intern. I want to move a level up and work at a top unicorn start-up like TikTok, Stripe, or Databricks when I graduate. I had the automated TikTok Hackerrank but I couldn't solve those leetcode hards. Can someone comment on their full interview process so I can start working on my skills relevant to them for next year? I can solve leetcode easies & some mediums, is this enough for Databricks and Stripe? Is there no way around TikTok / Bytedance other than grinding Leetcode Hards? Do I need system design too?
